content:
A photo from a walk on 15 June, 2024.
📷 OM-D E-M5 & 45 mm ƒ1.8, shot at ƒ8.

photos.alt: A photo of a path going around an old concrete wall with a small wooden fence near it. There is a lot of green grass growing around as well as some ferns. Beyond the wooden fence it seems to first go downhill, and then uphill, with the full frame covered by green fields and bushes, with no sky visible.
